{{Top|leg}}
The '''Malkite Ring''' was a shadowy organization of [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] operating throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The Ring specialized in assassinating high profile, well-protected targets such as wealthy [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] or [[Noble/Legends|nobles]]. Within the Ring, a deadly sect developed known as the [[Malkite Poisoners]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
